dialogues.speaker: Messenger
dialogues.text: Madam Faruzan! Letters from the students!

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Oh? They've finally decided to enroll? Let me see!

dialogues.speaker: Earnest Letter-Writer
dialogues.text: "Thank you for your invitation, Madam Faruzan. I've given this a lot of thought, and in the end, I think I'm gonna focus on Kshahrewar!"

dialogues.speaker: Respectful Letter-Writer
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Madam Faruzan, while I'm very interested in mechanisms and ancient texts, I'm stretched thin as it is. I need to focus on my other classes..."

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, Madam Faruzan, but I wanna study with Master for a little bit longer..."

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Seems like everyone's focused on themselves these days...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: ...But it's good to have a focus.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hey, folks. Don't place all your yolks in the same punnet. Broaden your horizons today, and find a new locus for your focus.
